document: IStructE/Concrete Society SMDS Ch5-6 — Diagram Analysis

diagrams.caption: Description of bond conditions

panels.a: bar inclined 45-90° during casting — GOOD bond all bars
panels.b: member h ≤ 250mm — GOOD bond all bars
panels.c: member h > 250mm — GOOD bond in unhatched zone (below 250mm from bottom); POOR in hatched (above 250mm); threshold = 300mm from bottom (INFERRED from 250mm cast position limit)
panels.d: member h > 600mm — GOOD bond in lower 300mm and inclined bars; POOR in hatched zones above 300mm

diagrams.caption: Values of cd for beams and slabs

panels.a_straight_bars: cd = min(a/2, c1, c) where a = clear spacing, c1 = side cover, c = bottom cover

diagrams.caption: Values of K for beams and slabs

panels.K_0_1: corner bar with transverse bar As at corner — K = 0.1
panels.K_0_05: single row bar with transverse — K = 0.05
panels.K_0: bar in element without transverse — K = 0

diagrams.caption: Adjacent laps

geometry.top_row: staggered laps; gap between laps ≥ 0.3×l0; bar diameter ø shown; end distance ≤ 50mm; offset ≤ 4ø
geometry.middle_row: adjacent laps with dimension 'a'; clear distance ≥ max(2ø, 20mm)

diagrams.caption: Transverse reinforcement for lapped splices

panels.a_tension: Transverse reinforcement (ΣAst/2) at each outer section of lap; within l0/3 from lap ends; gap ≤ 150mm between laps
panels.b_compression: Same as (a) PLUS one bar outside each end within 4ø of lap end

diagrams.caption: Additional reinforcement in anchorage for large dia bars

panels.left: n1=1, n2=2 — one layer of 2 bars anchored
panels.right: n1=2, n2=2 — two layers of 2 bars each

diagrams.caption: Anchorage of widely staggered bars in bundle
diagrams.geometry: Tension bar bundle; stagger ≥ l_b; stagger for dia-based lbd ≥ 1.3lb; section A-A shows bundle cross-section

diagrams.caption: Lap joint in tension including a fourth bar

geometry.constraint: max 4 bars in any lap cross-section

diagrams.caption: Lapping of welded fabric

panels.a_intermeshed: wires interleave — lap per EC2 rules
panels.b_layered: sheets stacked flat — lap in low-stress zones; 100% if As/s ≤ 1200mm²/m, 60% otherwise

diagrams.caption: Anchorage of bottom reinforcement at end supports

panels.a_direct_support: supported by wall/column; lbd starts from face of support; bar extends into support
panels.b_indirect_support: supported by another beam; lbd measured from line of contact

diagrams.caption: Adjacent laps (slab)

geometry.upper_pair: staggered laps; gap ≥ 0.3×l0; overlap ≤ 50mm; pitch ≤ 4ø from top

diagrams.caption: Simplified curtailment rules for top bars

internal_support.top_bars: four bars (a, b, c, d) with two alternating stagger positions (1, 2)
internal_support.extensions: a+b and c+d from support face; tension anchorage at cutoff; effective depth or 12×dia beyond zero moment

DXF_reconstruction.top_bars_plan_view: LINE segments at top of slab
DXF_reconstruction.dimensions: a, b, c, d labeled; tension anchorage dimension

diagrams.caption: Simplified curtailment rules for bottom bars

internal_span.end_condition: tension lap for bottom bars into support; tension anchorage at cutoff

diagrams.caption: Arrangement of reinforcement strips for two-way slabs

geometry.edge_strips: width Ly/8 and Lx/8 each side
geometry.edge_strip_bars: same dia and length as middle strip but pitch may increase to minimum reinforcement

diagrams.caption: Division of reinforcement strips for flat slabs

geometry.column_strip_x: Ly/4 each side of column centreline (total Ly/2)

diagrams.caption: Punching shear reinforcement
Illustration of the curtailment of longitudinal reinforcement in beams

geometry.tension_envelope: MEd/z + NEd envelope shown as dashed parabolic curve
geometry.resisting_force: stepped profile as bars are curtailed
geometry.anchorage_lengths: lbd shown at each cutoff point
geometry.al_shift: horizontal shift from zero-moment point to actual cutoff

diagrams.caption: Layout of reinforcement for flexible detailing of beams

elements.top_bars_internal: at top near support; curtailed in span
elements.bottom_splice_bars: at internal supports; lapped with span bars
elements.u_bars_at_end: at end support; top and bottom leg

diagrams.caption: Preferred arrangement of links
diagrams.geometry: Cross-section views showing enclosed + additional links for bar restraint; no overlap

diagrams.caption: Overlapping of links is NOT recommended
diagrams.geometry: Shows overlapping open links — explicitly marked as not recommended

diagrams.caption: Open links with top locking links

geometry.open_link: L-hook at top; 10ø hook; 75mm min straight extension
geometry.locking_link: horizontal bar across top to close the link

diagrams.caption: Required shape of torsion links
diagrams.geometry: Closed rectangular link with 135° hooks; hook extension = 10ø

DXF_reconstruction.extension: LINE of length 10ø beyond hook bend

diagrams.caption: Requirement of links in columns

panels.left: bars at < 150mm centres — every other bar restrained
panels.right: bars at > 150mm centres — each bar restrained

diagrams.caption: Links required for bursting at column laps

geometry.transverse_links: ΣAst/2 at each outer l0/3 section

diagrams.caption: Moment connection between beam and edge column

panels.u_bar: U-bar placed in beam depth; both legs horizontal; no penetration into column
panels.standard_bend: top bar bent down into column; standard bend radius acceptable with corner bar inside
panels.non_standard_bend: required if no corner bar; critical effective depth may vary; check thoroughly

diagrams.dimension_A: distance from face of column to nearest main reinforcement — determines whether U-bar or L-bar used

diagrams.caption: Shear enhancement of column
diagrams.geometry: Section through column showing horizontal U-bars extending into beam depth where no edge beam exists
